decision.summary: A multi-axis offset begins around index 545 (N/E drop ≈2–3 MAD, U dip shallower), persists to the end of allowed context (585) without observed return. The onset is multi-sample and coherent across N/E/U, but absence of recovery prevents confirmation as temporary; classified as uncertain.
